conventions.coordinates: Every paint and sample verb takes WORLD PIXEL coordinates, not chunks.
conventions.elements: Element ids are catalog-assigned and NOT stable across worlds — resolve them with engine_list_elements.
conventions.verification: Paint verbs read back what they painted; engine_sample_points inspects any point on demand.

files.note: No host mount — use list_world_files / read_world_file / write_world_file.
